name: GenBuster-Bench
description: GenBuster-Bench is a dataset designed to evaluate models' ability to detect or classify generated (synthetic) content—primarily in the visual domain—across a variety of generative sources. It is intended for benchmarking detection algorithms and robustness of classifiers against multiple generator types and perturbations. The dataset supports experiments on generalization and cross-generator detection performance.
reputation: A relatively new / specialized benchmark with limited adoption focused on generated-content detection research.
